bitcoin_articles.headline: Galaxy Digital Executes Large-Scale Bitcoin Transfers
bitcoin_articles.summary: Galaxy Digital has moved 500 BTC to newly created wallets, part of a broader repositioning effort involving over 1,500 BTC.

bitcoin_articles.headline: The Smarter Web Company Increases Bitcoin Holdings to 2,695 BTC
bitcoin_articles.summary: The Smarter Web Company PLC announced the purchase of 3 additional Bitcoin, bringing its total treasury holdings to 2,695 BTC.
